raw_description:
• Define outreach scenario/goal in natural language.
  • Choose desired call-to-action to drive next steps.
  • Provide subject line guidance: fixed suggestion or style recommendation.
  • Set message length and brevity targets.
  • Specify tone rules, including name-usage limits and preferred terminology.
  • Configure brand language and voice guardrails: approved phrases and banned words.
  • Set formatting preferences: bullets, paragraph length, and maximum bullet count.

Business Value:

This feature expands the Sales Qualification Agent outreach by letting teams define the outreach purpose, brand-aligned tone (matching both company voice and seller style), the call-to-action, and key messaging preferences proven to resonate with prospects. The result is more relevant, consistent communication that drives higher response rates and, in turn, improves lead qualification rates.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users
title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Personalize outreach emails generated by Sales Qualification Agent
